> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **17** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5f9e49f7f998a5faf614bc90e96e640938d8490e` — the merge of head `40c2c8aba3a162e105e7f26d7a4be8ed2f10e4bd` into base `af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5f9e49f7f998a5faf614bc90e96e640938d8490e && git checkout 5f9e49f7f998a5faf614bc90e96e640938d8490e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d 40c2c8aba3a162e105e7f26d7a4be8ed2f10e4bd && git checkout -B drift-repro af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d && git merge --no-ff 40c2c8aba3a162e105e7f26d7a4be8ed2f10e4bd

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs af3451b08bc39e7b4c163f52397cffe728b3e99d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 委托管理员只持有某个业务单元子树的管理范围时，`canReadObject`、`getReadFilter` 和 `security/explain` 现在都回答“能读，且只能读这几个单元”，和读门已经放行的结果一致。
- **为什么改：** 读门早已按裁决 6663849489 放行这类读取，但这三处回答还是“不能读”，单元选择器和 explain 会拒掉委托管理员实际能读的单元。这是多拒的问题，不会多放。
- **风险与回滚：** 三处共用读门的同一个判断函数。`canReadObject` 变成 true 的同时，`getReadFilter` 收窄到所覆盖的单元，所以绕过中间件的门也读不到范围外的单元（开发实测：只改前者会漏读）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `security-plugin-read-filter.ts` 的收窄（最关键）；`delegated-admin-gate.ts` 拆出的 `delegatedUnitReadAdmission`。
- **两分钟验证：** 见 PR 正文同名行。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地（非受管面）。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT。开放问题按 A 定：应用自建对象若以 `sys_business_unit` 为主表、读权限随主表（controlled_by_parent），委托管理员也能读到所覆盖单元下的明细。ADR-0055 规定明细读权限跟随主表；平台自带对象里没有这种明细。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · Head-sha: `40c2c8aba3a162e105e7f26d7a4be8ed2f10e4bd` · 2026-11-07T14:43Z

1. **Shape:** draft → main, `Fixes #30758`; `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` match the claim 6707031937. 8 files, all in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/**` plus the changeset (the claimed surface). `check-governed-merges --pr 31142`: NOT governed, 316 changed lines.
2. **Premise measured:** `delegatedUnitReadScope` reached main in eb96480dd60c (squash of #31031) and was applied only by the authz middleware; `canReadObject` and explain answered false/denies while the door served `bu_east` + subtree. The before column of the PR table was taken at base 5f0037449 in all three tenancy postures.
3. **Gates (check-runs at this head):** 48 runs, 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure, 0 pending. Dev's local reading: plugin-security 5820 passed after merging main; 64/64 derived gates exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED (report 6708113641).
4. **Accepted, read in the diff:** one judgment, `delegatedUnitReadAdmission`. The door's `delegatedUnitReadScope` now only checks for a query and delegates to it, with conditions unchanged: `sys_business_unit`, a read operation, own behalf, gate composed, at least one covered unit, fail closed. `canReadObject` arm 5 takes it only where no set grants `find`. The ADR-0055 master-derived scope passes no `ungrantedRead`, so `objectReadAdmission` there is unchanged. `getReadFilter` ANDs the `id $in` confinement where no set grants `find`. Explain's `object_crud` grants through it only where `agentCrud` is false, and never for an on-behalf-of principal or an unresolved posture. Its `readFilter` carries the confinement, and the record pass marks a unit outside it as not visible. Pinned in the shared posture harness (24 new cases, 3 postures). There are 9 ablation legs, each red and then restored, including "flip `canReadObject` without `getReadFilter`", which reads `bu_hq`.
5. **Open question (thread's Q):** ruled A by the seat (detail follows master per ADR-0055; B would give a second answer that disagrees with the master's read door). Nit, not blocking: `getReadFilter` resolves `getObjectSecurityMeta` before the judgment rejects a non-`sys_business_unit` object. That costs one extra meta read per call while the gate is composed, and the seat does not ask for a push for it. Out of scope: none filed. `Skills-docs:` n/a.
6. **Landing:** seat lands it (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` via the relay). On MERGED it checks that #30758 closed and removes `pm:dispatched`.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [42383103865](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/42383103865) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (3/8)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/42383103865/job/128435166865)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/runtime:test:  FAIL   local  src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts > [ADR-0106 D1] a standalone or object-less action entry is served as the object door projects it — /meta action do
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/runtime:test: AssertionError: usr_system item st_ping: expected '{"status":200,"body":{"type":"action"…' to be '{"status":200,"body":{"type":"action"…' // Object.is equality
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 18 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
